triples.subject: Father Zossima
triples.quote: The fact is that all the love that lay concealed in his pure young heart for every one and everything had, for the past year, been concentrated—and perhaps wrongly so—on one being, his beloved elder.

triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: what he saw before all was one figure—the figure of his beloved elder, the figure of that holy man whom he revered with such adoration.

triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: He remembered afterwards how, on that terrible day, he had entirely forgotten his brother Dmitri, about whom he had been so anxious and troubled the day before

triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: By the way, your brother Ivan set off to Moscow this morning, did you know?

triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: “I believed, I believe, I want to believe, and I will believe, what more do you want?” cried Alyosha irritably.

triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: And a whole year of life in the monastery had formed the habit of this expectation in his heart.

triples.subject: Rakitin
triples.quote: first a revengeful desire to see “the downfall of the righteous,” and Alyosha’s fall “from the saints to the sinners,” over which he was already gloating in his imagination

triples.subject: Madame Hohlakov
triples.quote: ‘she would never have expected _such conduct_ from a man of such a reverend character as Father Zossima.’ That was her very word: ‘conduct.’ She is angry too.
